title: Photographs of Ed Lansdale in Dealey Plaza identified by his wife

tellings.quote: Photographs of Lansdale sitting right there and his wife identifying it.

plain: Photographs show Ed Lansdale, a US military intelligence officer, in Dealey Plaza in Dallas, the square where President Kennedy was shot in 1963, according to a researcher named Dan Sheehan. Sheehan says the pictures show Lansdale "sitting right there," and that Lansdale's own wife identified him in them. If true, it would put an intelligence man at the scene of the killing.
